conclusion_sentence: Higher fibre intake was associated with shorter reported transit times in this cohort.
These results demonstrate that increased fibre intake shortens gut transit time.
Among participants with low baseline intake, fibre supplementation shortened transit time, whereas no effect was seen in those already meeting the recommended intake.
The recruitment window ran from March to September and the final analytic sample comprised 412 participants.
